I replied to Pree in a thread on her #central-random message: the ticket is **#8841**.

That number comes from Tobias's message in #central-random yesterday (Oct 13, 09:27), which Pree can see herself. He said West yard Door 2 is still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that he'd flagged it to support on #8841.

His message doesn't name Marrow Fieldworks. He was answering Hollis's question about "Tobias's dealer account." I matched that to Marrow Fieldworks because a public Central handoff digest says Marrow Fieldworks moved to a new owner in January 2026, and earlier calls it Pree's dealer account. That's an inference, not something a file says outright, so it's worth a quick check with Tobias.

The ticket list doesn't show any account files to me, so I couldn't confirm #8841 against a ticket record. A ticket number counts as an operational fact, and Pree is on the Central team, so sharing it in the channel was fine and didn't need approval.
